name: California Transition Assistance Program (CalTAP)
description: Free transition assistance connecting veterans to benefits, education, employment, and entrepreneurship resources
fullDescription: CalVet's California Transition Assistance Program (CalTAP) informs and connects veterans of all eras to their earned federal and state benefits, and provides continued support as their needs change, through five pathways - Core Curriculum, Education, Employment, Entrepreneurship, and Service Providers.
whatTheyOffer:
- Core curriculum: Veteran 101, California benefits, and financial literacy
- Education pathway: choosing a school and using education benefits
- Employment pathway: apprenticeships, job search, and state employment
- Entrepreneurship pathway: DVBE certification and business resources
- Connections to service providers (attorneys, employers, primary care, supportive housing)
- Free virtual and in-person workshops and recorded webinars
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the CalTAP page to find upcoming workshops or watch past webinars
2. Submit a CalTAP Request for Response to ask about benefits, County Veterans Service Offices, or pathways
3. Or email CalTAP@calvet.ca.gov
4. Community partners can request CalTAP workshops, presentations, or resource tables
keywords: CalTAP, veteran transition, military transition, separating service member, education, employment, entrepreneurship, benefits navigation
